title: nf-core/oceangenomesdraftgenomes pipeline parameters
description: An nf-core pipeline for draft genome assembly, mitogenome assembly and LCA for species validation from Illumina short read data.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to comma-separated file containing information about the samples in the experiment.
input.help_text: You will need to create a design file with information about the samples in your experiment before running the pipeline. Use this parameter to specify its location. It has to be a comma-separated file with 3 columns, and a header row. See [usage docs](https://nf-co.re/oceangenomesdraftgenomes/usage#samplesheet-input).

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

kvalue.description: k value to use with Meryl.

genomescope2_l.description: Optional GenomeScope2 -l flag value; use false to disable.

genomescope2_m.description: GenomeScope2 -m/--max_kmercov: k-mers above this coverage are excluded from the model fit. Raising it does not recover host mass -- the estimate climbs without ever plateauing and the gain lands entirely in repeat length -- so raise it only for a sample with evidence its genomic signal is truncated.

tiara_min_len.description: tiara --min_len. Contigs shorter than this are not classified. tiara's own default of 3000 leaves most of a fragmented short-read assembly unscreened.

fcs_review_action.description: How to treat contigs FCS-GX marks REVIEW: exclude removes all of them, short-only removes only those <= 1000 bp (pre-Sept-2026 behaviour), keep retains them all.

genomescope_min_model_fit.description: Minimum GenomeScope Model Fit (upper bound, percent) below which the genome size estimate is flagged unreliable and coverage is not graded. The upper bound is the fit to the modelled region; the lower bound is a residual over whatever genomescope2_m admitted and moves with that setting.

genomescope_max_model_bias.description: Maximum GenomeScope bias coefficient. A large bias term is the model buying agreement with a shape that is not a diploid k-mer spectrum.

genomescope_min_peak_kmercov_ratio.description: Minimum ratio of the observed k-mer histogram mode to GenomeScope's fitted kmercov. Below this the fitted coverage sits above a mode the histogram does not show.

genomescope_peak_search_max.description: Coverage ceiling for k-mer peak detection. Independent of genomescope2_m on purpose: tying the search range to the model cutoff made the flag move whenever the cutoff moved.

kmer_depth_min_mapq.description: MAPQ floor for read depth over Complete BUSCO genes. Depth at Q0 and Q20 agreed within 3% on every sample tested, so this is not what makes a low-coverage sample look low-coverage.

kmer_depth_min_regions.description: Minimum usable Complete BUSCO regions before a measured lambda is reported. Falling below it usually means the BUSCO table and the BAM describe different assemblies.

kmer_depth_max_ratio.description: How far GenomeScope's fitted kmercov may sit from the lambda measured from read depth before the size estimate is flagged. A factor of two here is a factor of two in the genome size, so the ceiling sits below it: fitting the homozygous peak as heterozygous or the reverse is GenomeScope's characteristic failure.

host_depth_window.description: Multiplicative half-width of the host depth band used to partition an assembly into host and symbiont mass. A contig counts as host when host_depth / window <= meandepth <= host_depth * window.

host_depth_min_contig.description: Contigs shorter than this are excluded from the depth partition. At a few hundred bases a mean depth is noise, and the contig would otherwise be assigned by it.

kmer_depth_min_seedable.description: Measured lambda below which no reseed is attempted. There is no host peak to fit at that coverage, and forcing the optimiser there produces fits of a few percent with non-finite genome lengths.

genomescope_reseed_when_flagged.description: Refit GenomeScope seeded with the measured lambda when the first fit was flagged unreliable. The reseeded fit is kept only if it beats the original.

genomescope_min_reseed_fit_gain.description: Points of model_fit_full a reseeded fit must gain before it replaces the original. It must also move kmercov toward the measured lambda.

report_subdir.description: Subdirectory for the run-level aggregate reports (coverage_summary, multiqc). Set it per launch when several launches share one outdir, so they do not overwrite each other's copy.

genomescope_min_assembly_ratio.description: Lower bound on GenomeScope genome size divided by decontaminated assembly size before the estimate is flagged. Catches a model that converged cleanly onto something that is not the genome.

genomescope_max_assembly_ratio.description: Upper bound on GenomeScope genome size divided by decontaminated assembly size before the estimate is flagged.

genomescope_max_peak_kmercov_ratio.description: How far the observed k-mer histogram mode may sit from GenomeScope's fitted kmercov before the size estimate is flagged. A mode at 1x or 2x kmercov is normal.

bs_config.description: Path to BaseSpace CLI config file for downloads.

sql_config.description: Path to PostgreSQL connection config for metadata upload/lookup.

taxonkit_db_dir.description: Directory holding (or to cache) the NCBI taxdump. Used to resolve taxon_id/class for samples the curated species table does not carry. Without it, unmatched samples abort the run.

ramdisk_path.description: Path to RAM disk directory for FCS-GX.

kraken2_db.description: Path to a kraken2 database directory (must contain hash.k2d, opts.k2d and taxo.k2d) used for read-level decontamination before assembly.

kraken2_confidence.description: kraken2 --confidence threshold. The kraken2 default of 0 assigns a read on a single k-mer hit, which discards real host sequence for taxa with poor reference coverage.

kraken2_exclude_taxids.description: Space-separated NCBI taxids whose reads (and descendants) are removed before assembly. Default is Bacteria, Archaea and Viruses.

megahit_checkpoint_unkeyed.description: What to do with a MEGAHIT checkpoint written before checkpoint fingerprinting existed.
megahit_checkpoint_unkeyed.help_text: MEGAHIT checkpoints live outside the work directory so a failed assembly can resume, which means Nextflow cannot tell whether one matches the current inputs. Checkpoints are now fingerprinted; ones written earlier carry no fingerprint and their inputs are unknowable. 'invalidate' discards and reassembles them. 'adopt' claims them for the current inputs, which is only safe when you know the reads and assembly arguments have not changed.

megahit_stale_checkpoint.description: What to do with a MEGAHIT checkpoint whose input fingerprint no longer matches.
megahit_stale_checkpoint.help_text: 'rerun' discards it and reassembles. 'archive' moves it to <dir>.stale.<timestamp> first, which preserves it for forensics at the cost of a second copy of the intermediate graph. 'fail' stops the task, for runs where an unexpected reassembly is worse than a crash.

megahit_checkpoint_cleanup.description: Prune the intermediate assembly graph from a MEGAHIT checkpoint once it completes.
megahit_checkpoint_cleanup.help_text: A completed checkpoint can never be continued, so its intermediate contigs and temporary files are dead weight, tens of GB per sample retained under the output directory. Pruning leaves the resume-skip path fully working.

busco_metazoa_db.description: Path to BUSCO Metazoa database, used for invertebrates.

busco_crustacea_db.description: Path to BUSCO crustacea_odb12 database, used for Malacostraca, Thecostraca, Branchiopoda, Copepoda and Ostracoda.

busco_mollusca_db.description: Path to BUSCO mollusca_odb12 database, used for Gastropoda, Bivalvia, Polyplacophora, Cephalopoda, Scaphopoda and Monoplacophora.

busco_anthozoa_db.description: Path to BUSCO anthozoa_odb12 database, used for Anthozoa.

busco_arthropoda_db.description: Path to BUSCO arthropoda_odb12 database, used for arthropod classes with no narrower lineage (Pycnogonida, Merostomata, Chilopoda, Diplopoda).

mitogenome_nfcore_dir.description: Path to nf-core/oceangenomesmitogenomes pipeline for triggered mitogenome runs.

pooled.description: Path to pooled reads directory (used when skip_download_reads is true).

skip_bs_download.description: Skip BaseSpace download module and use bs_fastq_glob for local FASTQs.

bs_fastq_glob.description: Glob path to locally available FASTQ files to use when skip_bs_download is true.

curated_blast_db.description: Curated BLAST DB path for downstream mitogenome/LCA workflows.

schema_input.description: Path to input schema used for samplesheet validation.

skip_kraken2_decontamination.description: Skip kraken2 read-level decontamination and assemble the fastp reads directly.

skip_upload_results.description: Skip uploading QC metrics to SQL database.

precomputed_download_reads_results.description: Glob for precomputed paired FASTQs if download is skipped.

precomputed_fastp_fastqc_results.description: Glob for precomputed fastp FASTQs when skipping fastp/fastqc.

precomputed_fastp_json.description: Glob for precomputed fastp JSON reports.

precomputed_genome_assembly_results.description: Glob for precomputed genome assemblies when assembly is skipped.

precomputed_genomescope_summary.description: Glob for precomputed GenomeScope summary files.

precomputed_genomescope_model.description: Glob for precomputed GenomeScope model files, needed for the read-depth comparison when the k-mer stage is skipped.

precomputed_meryl_hist.description: Glob for precomputed meryl histograms, which GENOMESCOPE_RESEED refits.

precomputed_coverage_summary.description: Glob for precomputed coverage summary JSON files, needed so the assembly cross-check can run when the k-mer stage is skipped.

precomputed_meryl_results.description: Glob for precomputed meryl db directories.

precomputed_genome_decontamination_resul.description: Glob for precomputed decontaminated assemblies when decontamination is skipped.

precomputed_genome_qc_results.description: Glob for precomputed genome QC outputs.

precomputed_busoco_short_summary_results.description: Glob for precomputed BUSCO short summaries.

refreshModules.description: Whether to refresh DSL2 module cache.

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

max_job_request_options.title: Max job request options
max_job_request_options.description: Set the top limit for requested resources for any single job.
max_job_request_options.help_text:
If you are running on a smaller system, a pipeline step requesting more resources than are available may cause the Nextflow to stop the run with an error. These options allow you to cap the maximum resources requested by any single job so that the pipeline will run on your system.

Note that you can not _increase_ the resources requested by any job using these options. For that you will need your own configuration file. See [the nf-core website](https://nf-co.re/usage/configuration) for details.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any single job.
max_cpus.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the CPU requirement for each process. Should be an integer e.g. `--max_cpus 1`

max_memory.description: Maximum amount of memory that can be requested for any single job.
max_memory.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the memory requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_memory '8.GB'`

max_time.description: Maximum amount of time that can be requested for any single job.
max_time.help_text: Use to set an upper-limit for the time requirement for each process. Should be a string in the format integer-unit e.g. `--max_time '2.h'`

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

hook_url.description: Incoming hook URL for messaging service
hook_url.help_text: Incoming hook URL for messaging service. Currently, MS Teams and Slack are supported.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.
